question.value: Do quiescent galaxies in the z=3.09 SSA22 proto-cluster core hold detectable molecular gas (CO(3-2)) and dust, and what does this imply for their quenching and progenitors

evidence.quote: We present a study of the molecular gas reservoirs and dust contents in three quiescent galaxies (QGs) located in the core of the $z=3.09$ SSA22 proto-cluster.
The observations were conducted as part of ALMA project 2023.1.01206.S (PI: Umehata).
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00162.S, #2017.1.01332.S,#2023.1.01206.S.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00162.S, #2017.1.01332.S,#2023.1.01206.S.
The observations were performed over 21 runs during ALMA Cycle 10 (between January and September 2024) using the Band-3 receiver.

referee_caveats_inferred: Detection is 5.6 sigma at a single peak flux density measurement; no spectral line-free/baseline details, so false-positive probability and flux uncertainty are not demonstrated
Line intensity is a peak flux density in the moment-0 map, not an integrated flux over the source; extended emission or beam dilution could bias M_H2
alpha_CO and r_31 are assumed, spanning a factor 5.5 in M_H2, so the gas fraction conclusion depends on them
Dust mass limit relies on assumed T_d = 20 K and beta = 2, which is questionable for a quiescent galaxy
Quenching and progenitor arguments rest on toy closed-box models and on companion papers still in preparation

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Several tens to a few hundred GB for the 21 execution blocks of project 2023.1.01206.S (about 17 h on source, 4 spectral windows), before imaging; 2013.1.00162.S and 2017.1.01332.S would add more if used
reproducibility.score_reason: Main numbers (CO flux, z, sigma, M_H2, limits) are given and the imaging recipe is partly stated (natural weighting, 2 sigma auto-masking, CASA 6.5.4), but extraction apertures, conversion formulas, calibration route and key inputs from papers in preparation are missing, and the paper never states that the data are public.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, and the flux extraction aperture and L'_CO conversion are not given, so the numeric results cannot be redone from the text alone.
